bg.description: The page and the panel at night.

bg-raised.description: The one step up, for surfaces that sit over the page: the flowchart panel and its label pills, the certificate dialog, work nodes and decision rows. Not the bar, which is the page ground with a rule underline, and not a card style.

ink-2.description: Secondary labels and the copy control’s text. Ghost-button text is ink.

grid.description: The column lines behind the introduction, below rule.

rule.description: Separates rows and closes the bar.

rule-strong.description: Outlines a control that can be pressed.

track.description: The unfilled part of a track or rail.

lamp-off.description: An unlit lamp; the same darkness as an empty track.

accent.description: A lit lamp, the live token, the current item, the glow, focus.

accent-hover.description: The hover of an amber fill.

accent-text.description: Amber as text, kept separate so it passes contrast on the ground.

on-accent.description: Text on an amber fill; a brown-black, not the ground.

lamp-edge.description: The hairline ring around a lit lamp.

fail.description: Failure semantics in the flowcharts only; never a UI colour.

flow-label.description: Flowchart text in viewBox units; 12px floor.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The easing for the fast transitions.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: A lamp lighting or going out.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: A hero cell lighting under the pointer.

motion.name: wave
motion.purpose: The hero cells' slow wave; the owner's low-frequency floor.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: The signal ray's cycle, inside the owner's 20-30s window.

motion.name: strip-step
motion.purpose: Each strip starts this long after the one before, so the charge crosses the page.

breakpoints.name: art-vertical
breakpoints.purpose: Now lanes stack; the Work node structure collapses.

breakpoints.name: bar-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: The bar collapses into a menu button.

breakpoints.name: flow-ticket-vertical
breakpoints.purpose: Where Ticket-Pipeline's desktop chart would fall below 1:1.

breakpoints.name: flow-rannaghor-vertical
breakpoints.purpose: Where RannaGhor's desktop chart would fall below 1:1.

breakpoints.name: page-max
breakpoints.purpose: The frame width; the 12-column grid lives inside it.

fonts.note: Both faces are self-hosted with metric-matched fallbacks, so a cold visit reflows nothing.

flowchart.note: A label is legal only if its pill is 6 units nearer its own edge than any other stroke, on both layouts (only the seat search's seed differs). No height clamp may return (Ruling 12). A cluster's entry edge is drawn in a 30-unit band under its heading so it keeps its label.

components.name: Bar
components.description: Sticky control bar: accent wordmark, five nav links with lamps, a CV action.
components.html: Toshifur Rahman
components.css: .site-header {position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; background: var(--bg); border-bottom: var(--line) solid var(--rule);}

components.name: Nav link
components.description: A bar or sub-nav entry; muted at rest, ink when current, its lamp lit amber.
components.css: .nav-links a {position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: var(--target); padding-right: var(--space-4); padding-left: var(--space-3); color: var(--muted); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); white-space: nowrap; transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);}

components.name: Primary button
components.description: An amber fill with on-accent text; Download CV in the hero.
components.css: .button {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: var(--target); padding: 0 var(--space-5); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); border-radius: var(--radius); transition: background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: A ruled control: ink text on a rule-strong outline, accent text and border on hover.
components.css:
.ghost {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: var(--target); padding: 0 var(--space-4); border: var(--line) solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: var(--text-md); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--ink); transition: border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);}

components.name: Case card
components.description: A work card: a ruled row, one rule line on top, no background of its own, with a node diagram at its centre.
components.css: .case {position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-5) var(--col-gap); padding-block: var(--space-8); border-top: var(--line) solid var(--rule);}

components.name: Copy email button
components.description: Copies the address; mono 2xs on a strong rule, amber on hover.
components.css: .copy-button {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--target); padding: 0 var(--space-4); border: var(--line) solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: var(--text-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-mono); text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer;}

components.name: Flow node
components.description: A box in a case study's flowchart, drawn on the page's own ground with a strong-rule outline.
components.css:
.flow-node text {font-family: var(--mono); font-size: var(--flow-label); letter-spacing: 0.03em; fill: var(--ink-2); text-transform: uppercase;} .flow-node rect {fill: var(--bg); stroke: var(--rule-strong); stroke-width: var(--line); transition: fill var(--dur-lamp) linear,
    stroke var(--dur-lamp) linear;}

components.name: Flow edge label
components.description: A pill and its text on an edge; must own its seat by 6 units.
components.css: .flow-edge-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: var(--flow-label); fill: var(--muted); } .flow-edge-pill { fill: var(--bg); }

components.name: Signal strip
components.description: The decorative ray that runs from the wordmark down the page's strips.
components.css: .site-rail { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; display: grid; width: min(100% - 2 * var(--frame-margin), var(--frame)); margin-inline: auto; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; } .site-rail i { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; left: 0; width: var(--line); background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--accent) 45%, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); opacity: 0; }

components.name: Hero cell
components.description: One of eleven glow cells between the column lines; the wave lights it.
components.css: .hero-cell { margin-inline: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--accent) 30%, var(--accent) 70%, transparent); opacity: 0; animation: hero-wave var(--dur-wave) ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: calc(var(--cell-index, 0) * var(--strip-step) * -3); }

narrative.overview: A control panel for a working engineer. Everything sits inside one 12-column frame drawn by two hairlines, and colour is spent on one thing: an amber signal that says where you are. The ground reads as an instrument panel at night; every section is a readout rather than a boxed card, and a Work card is a ruled row. Charge runs from the wordmark down the page's strips to the footer, and cells between the strips glow as it passes. It is slow, it is decoration, and it stops under prefers-reduced-motion. This replaces an earlier language (Archivo, a vermilion accent, a five-state chain as navigation) that is no longer on the site.
keyCharacteristics: One frame, twelve columns, two hairlines, on every page.
Dark first: :root is the night panel and the light theme is a token swap, not an inversion.
One accent, amber, for the live signal, the wordmark and the way forward.
Mono type wherever a number, label or system name appears; Sans for prose.
Flat and hairline: 1px rules, 6px radii, no shadows, no filled cards behind body copy, and a card is ruled rather than raised.
The chart engine is part of the design language, so its rules are design rules.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber means live or go. It marks the current item, the lit lamp, the charge, the primary action and the focused control. It is never a heading colour, a section background, or decoration.

rules.name: The Two Rule Strengths Rule
rules.body: rule separates rows; rule-strong outlines something pressable. Do not reach for a third grey.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: A number, a station, a stack, a label or a system name is Martian Mono. A sentence is Mona Sans. A line never mixes the two.

rules.name: The Diagram Floor Rule
rules.body: No flowchart text may render below 12px, measured from the rendered transform (getScreenCTM().a), not from the viewBox. The floor wins over fitting the chart in one window.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: Every page sits inside the 84rem frame with its two hairlines and twelve columns. Nothing is placed outside it.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: There is bg and bg-raised and nothing above. No shadows, no blur, no translucent surfaces except an overlay backdrop.

rules.name: The Heading Names a Group Rule
rules.body: On the vertical flowchart layout a cluster heading names the group but does not stand in for the edge that enters it: that edge is drawn as a short arrow under the heading, so the route or the failure reaching the group keeps its label.

rules.name: The Motion Is Decoration Rule
rules.body: The wave and the pulse carry no information, pause out of view and on a hidden tab, and vanish under reduced motion.

dos: Do put every page inside the frame, with the 12 columns and both hairlines.
Do spend amber on the live signal only: current item, lit lamp, charge, primary action, focus.
Do set numbers, labels, stacks and system names in Martian Mono, and prose in Mona Sans.
Do separate with a 1px rule and outline a pressable control with rule-strong.
Do keep targets at 2.75rem and keep the visible focus ring.
Do stop all signature motion under reduced motion and give the flowchart its still picture.
Do hold every flowchart label to the invariants, including the 12px floor read from the rendered transform.
donts: Don’t add a second accent, or use fail as a UI colour.
Don’t put a filled card behind body copy; bg-raised is for controls and readouts.
Don’t add shadows, blur or a third elevation step.
Don’t introduce a third rule strength or a third text weight.
Don’t let the chart shrink to fit: the floor wins and the panel scrolls.
Don’t special-case a single label, or seat a label by eye where a rule decides.
Don’t bring back the height clamp, or re-describe the pre-Signal-Box chain design.
